name: Gloina Shieldwall
portraitDescription: Strong and broad-shouldered, with skin tones often lighter than hill dwarves. Known for their strength and craftsmanship. Wearing shining heavy armor with divine motifs, carrying a glowing weapon and shield, looking noble. The character is exceptionally attractive and a pleasure to look at, with elegant features. Key features: thick beard, broad shoulders, heavy plate armor, ornate metalwork.
